parallels.note: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

translations.web: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
translations.bsb: Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
translations.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
translations.asv: He had yet one, a beloved son: he sent him last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
